stages.title: API inventory and stable baselines
stages.boundaries: Complete the S00 responsibility defined in implementation.md.
stages.acceptance: Pinned stable release exports, fields, style schemas and inherited host contracts are inventoried, with unique IDs, stage owners, six support cells, provenance, and explicit investigation obligations. Implementation and runtime verification remain pending.
stages.nextAction: Begin S01 scaffolding.

stages.title: Workspace scaffolding
stages.boundaries: Bun workspace, stable tooling, TypeScript/Biome config, ESM build, blank root/package README files, harness skeletons and required script entrypoints. No feature compatibility claim.
stages.acceptance: Clean install, Biome check, typecheck and build pass; published file list is inspected; absent suites fail explicitly as pending.
stages.nextAction: Implement S02 portable contracts.

stages.title: Portable contracts
stages.boundaries: Own portable values, named driver interface, validation, errors, diagnostics and option-specific capability policies. No renderer compatibility certification.
stages.acceptance: Static positive/negative API consumers and meaningful portable tests pass; common declarations import without backend peers; public contracts recorded in decision0002.
stages.nextAction: Portable contracts accepted; verify feature behavior in each owning stage.

stages.title: Explicit adapter selection
stages.boundaries: Conditional exports, explicit selected adapters, provider and map-ID context/ref registration. No renderer feature or native linking claim.
stages.acceptance: Provider misuse and duplicate/missing IDs have tested errors; packed declarations and selected runtime exports resolve in browser/Metro with both mixed configurations; selected peers suffice.
stages.nextAction: Begin S04 renderer lifecycle and retain all real-renderer/native binary gates.
deliverables: Provider/context, map registration and reactive readiness
Four explicit adapters and browser-first aliases
Packed selected-peer and mixed Metro/browser resolution evidence
scenarios: provider/context misuse
registry instance cleanup
missing-selected-peer
explicit/alias package resolution
both mixed engine dependency graphs

stages.title: Map lifecycle
stages.boundaries: Map creation, positive host sizing/resize, ordinary selected configuration, initial style/camera, readiness and attached-ref ownership, provider/external-context disposal, and inherited host forwarding. Camera commands, movement/gesture events, source/layer schemas and style replacement remain in their owners. Includes S04.generated-host; completion does not accept M1.
stages.acceptance: All owned coverage has implementation/explicit disposition and static/component evidence; actual creation/sizing/initialstate/cleanup pass in six environments, including both isolated native build identities.
commands: Selected isolated native Release builds and tests/native-runtime/mapbox-s04-acceptance.yaml / maplibre-s04-verified.yaml
stages.nextAction: User aborted native acceptance. Current artifact passed routine checks, both browser lifecycle/configuration/replay suites and mixed Metro transports. Mapbox Android and MapLibre iOS Release builds/installations passed; native runtime acceptance remains incomplete. Require renewed permission before any further tests. Previous native acceptance remains historical; later feature stages remain planned.
deliverables: Four lifecycle adapters and owned native resize/style-observation composition
Typed host/configuration factories; web named settings and Mapbox native layout snapshot
Provider-owned browser reuse and transferred WebGL2 context lifecycle
Exact packed artifact, isolated selected-peer consumers and six runtime evidence cells
Coverage dispositions, retained failure/rerun history and guide-reviewed documentation
scenarios: Actual initial style, nonzero initial camera/padding and ignored later initialization
Pre-ready commands, positive/zero/restored layout, explicit SDK resize and late-detach rejection
Real loading failure, requested error delivery, no-handler boundary and clean remount
Host attributes, identity/accessibility update-removal and latest receiving-host callbacks
Web settings getter/setter/default-reset; constructor validation/immutability and SDK initialization
Multiple active maps, one dormant renderer, provider isolation, callbacks silence/reset and disposal
Transferred WebGL2 pixels, context sizing, constructor failure, same-commit retirement and SDK loss
Packed common and selected peers, declaration/export/alias/browser/Metro graphs and native linking identity

configurationContract.selectedFactory: Web selected createMapConfiguration supplies immutable initial options; Mapbox native selected factory supplies mutable tint string/normalized RGBA options, all accepted by Map.configuration
configurationContract.scope: Explicit selected configuration, common SDK-free opaque type; promise-based web getMapSettings and native Mapbox getMapLayout keep selected extensions/lifetimes explicit
configurationContract.ownership: Initial camera snapshot ignores later valid values. Constructor changes require remount; equivalent snapshots accepted. Native tint updates/removal restore original SDK color. Named web settings reset defaults. Provider-owned bounded reuse disables upstream static pools; WebGL2 context transfer distinguishes reservations from consumed/retiring SDK ownership
configurationContract.invalidInput: Foreign/forged config, wrongbackend, unknown keys, malformed values and incompatible live context ownership reject before selected dispatch with InvalidMapOptionError
configurationContract.acceptance: Current packed selected-peer declarations, independent source-supported expectations, meaningful positive/negative units/components and actual selected SDK readbacks/disposal; specialized host effects outside forwarding contract remain separately qualified

stages.acceptedArtifactRole: Historical six-environment runtime acceptance; current adapter ownership artifact has browser acceptance, with native acceptance pending.
